2610.12176.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
2610.12176.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
2610.12176.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改進（RSI）在無法驗證的任務上，例如開放式研究，當其輸出超過人類專家能可靠評估的範圍時，面臨監督瓶頸，這使得模型本身（優化對象）成為最佳可用的優化器和評估者。然而，單一模型實例在這種同質循環下難以批評和改進其自身的複雜推理。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了多代理自我監督（MASS），這是一種RSI方法，交替進行進化工作流優化和對自生成軌跡的監督微調。根據早期發現，多代理拓撲在複雜推理方面表現出色，MASS促使單一基礎模型迭代地提出、執行和自我評估多代理工作流。通過受結構護欄約束的進化搜索，模型優化這些類計算圖的協調，發現針對特定任務最有效的不同角色和信息路由。在兩個使用Qwen3.6-27B的MASS循環中，該模型在四個開放式公共基準上每個輸出標記的性能提高了1.2-1.6倍。由於改進後的模型隨後作為更好的優化器和評估者，這種交替框架使模型能力的持續遞歸自我啟動成為可能。此外，多代理軌跡的訓練效率也更高：在其上訓練的學生超越了在1.4倍更多訓練標記上訓練的單代理學生。這些發現表明，從多代理軌跡共同學習協調和有界子代理執行可以為RSI提供有效的信號。
